answer: Each identity locks 70 credits and files a key-signed claim to a grove plot in the oasis registry, ember-sealed. Auditors replay the oasis registry: conflicting claims from one key prove equivocation, and both bonds burn. Ember beacon spot-checks one in eight. A first fake pays 104; the thousandth costs 6,028, so 1,000 fakes spend 3,101,000 chasing a 40,000 pool, and rented-claim rings lose. An honest agent claims one grove and keeps its bond.
